pageDescription: Membership at Christ The King is about more than attending—it's about belonging, growing, and serving together.
benefitsIntro: Membership provides a framework for mutual commitment, accountability, and growth.

benefits.description: Become part of a caring community committed to walking together in faith.

benefits.title: Voting Rights
benefits.description: Participate in congregational meetings and help shape the direction of CTK.

benefits.title: Meaningful Ministry Roles
benefits.description: Access to significant ministry positions and leadership opportunities.

benefits.title: Spiritual Development

ctaDescription: We'd love to talk with you about becoming a member of Christ the King. Contact Fr. David Allert to begin the conversation.
